action_visual: a young couple argues at the counter, the girl crying that he never listens, the boy saying she is always like this, while Su Nian stands behind the counter unsure whether to interject
source_text: 一对年轻情侣在吧台前吵起来了。你从来不听我说话

action_visual: the young man orders two lattes, slams his wallet on the table; Su Nian serves them, the girl lowers her head and does not drink, then the boy stands and goes to the restroom
source_text: 男孩点了两杯拿铁，摔了钱包。男孩去洗手间

action_visual: Su Nian looks at the girl's still-steaming latte, picks it up and closes her eyes
the world falls silent; a shallow, simple grievance surfaces — the girl only wanted him to remember her birthday, just once
inner_voice: ……他不知道我为什么生气。他永远不知道。我只是想让他记住我的生日，就一次……
source_text: 他不知道我为什么生气。我只是想让他记住我的生日

action_visual: Su Nian sets the cup down; the cost is small — reading a stranger only loses a trivial memory; she looks at her left inner wrist where a small scratch she never recalled has vanished
source_text: 代价应该很小。左手手腕内侧一道小划痕消失了。无所谓

action_visual: the boy returns; Su Nian leans to whisper in the girl's ear to tell him the real reason she's angry — the birthday
spoken_dialogue: 告诉他你为什么生气。不是因为那件事，是因为生日。
source_text: 苏念在女孩耳边轻声说：告诉他你为什么生气，是因为生日

action_visual: ten minutes later the boy kneels before the girl, pulling a crumpled pair of movie tickets from his pocket — next Tuesday, her birthday — and the girl laughs through her tears
source_text: 男孩跪下来，掏出两张电影票，女孩生日那天。女孩哭着笑了

action_visual: clearing up, Su Nian notices a pink lipstick print on the girl's latte cup rim — but she wore no lipstick when she drank it
focus_object: pink lipstick print on the cup rim
source_text: 女孩的拿铁杯沿有一个粉色唇印。她刚才喝的时候没涂口红

action_visual: Su Nian washes the cup, hot water erasing the print; she looks at her hands — nothing missing — but feels a tiny hollow inside, like a pulled tooth the tongue keeps seeking
focus_object: hot water erasing the lipstick print
source_text: 热水冲掉唇印。她心里有一个微小的空洞。积少成多
